[LGRA.10.7] **A service may require a literal.** A service declaration may mark
one of its kwargs `literal`. At a `call` of that service, the value given for
such a kwarg must be a literal, and the compiler must refuse anything else with
`DS_VALIDATE_DYNAMIC_IDENT_KWARG`, naming the kwarg and the service. A literal
here is an `INT_LIT`, `FLOAT_LIT` or `UNIT_LIT`, which may be preceded by `-`
as a kwarg's `default` may ([LGRA.23.1]); a `BOOL_LIT`; or a `STRING_LIT` with
no interpolation site ([LGRA.2.9.6]), since a site is rendered at the firing.
The call's other kwargs keep [LGRA.10.6]'s freedom.
